Close to the Hebrew; דָּמִיתִי (“destroy” or “liken”) is rendered “I have likened.”
Close to the Hebrew; “consecrate battle” is rendered “Prepare war.”
Close to the Hebrew; “fortresses” is rendered “palaces.”
Close to the Hebrew; “visited” is rendered “punished.”
Close to the Hebrew; “keeps cool” is rendered “wells up.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV reads the imperative “pour it out” as God’s first-person reply, “I will pour it out.”
Close to the Hebrew; “gaining unjust gain” is rendered “given to covetousness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “on a trifling thing” is rendered “slightly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “exhibit shame” is rendered “blush,” and “visited” “punish.”
Close to the Hebrew; “schemes” is rendered “thoughts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “javelin” is rendered “spear.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִבְצָר (“fortress” or “tester”) is rendered “a fortress.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV follows the Qere “by the fire,” and “someone has refined” is rendered “The smelter refines.”
